selection: Convenience feasibility sample informed by source availability and reported-statistic search results; not representative or outcome-blinded sampling.
source: Europe PMC fullTextXML; article-specific CC BY or CC0 evidence required before distribution
case_selection: First two eligible explicitly reported t, F, z or chi-square statistics in main-body order, with degrees of freedom when required and an explicit p-value/relation. No selection based on auditor outputs. Eligibility/mapping exclusions and any deviation must be recorded.
scope: Conditional reported-statistic/p-value consistency, not substantive scientific validity, test appropriateness or data authenticity.
labels: All reviewer identities, decisions and adjudications remain unfilled. No expert labels or performance estimates will be generated.
legacy_pilot: Existing 2026-11-06 preregistration and frozen inputs remain unchanged.
case_selection_clarification: Main-body narrative paragraphs, excluding table cells, figure captions, abstract and references. This operational clarification was made during manual eligibility inspection, before any auditor run; it was not registered in advance.

screening.reason: Reported F values use PERMANOVA/permutation reference distributions with one displayed degree of freedom. Later chi-square p-prime values are explicitly multiplicity-corrected. Neither is eligible for the unadjusted parametric tail target; no missing denominator degrees of freedom were invented.
No eligible explicit statistic, required degrees of freedom and p-value triplet was found in the main-body narrative. Supplement-only results were outside the declared case-selection scope.
